newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius sees sales, profit growth in 97.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius sees sales, profit growth in 97.

text.p: German medical group Fresenius AG said on Tuesday it expected further sales and profit growth in 1997 after group net profit rose 45 percent to 132 million marks ($76.9 million) in 1996.
"The development for the group in the current business year continues to be positive despite increasingly difficult business conditions," Fresenius said in a statement.
Innovative products and leading production technologies will underpin growth in the future, the company added.
"For the entire business year of 1997 we look for further growth in profit and sales," the statement said.
Fresenius Medical (FMC), which was created in October 1996 after Fresenius purchased U.S. medical group National Medical Care, said it was also optimistic about its 1997 earnings.
FMC business should expand through internal growth and strategic acquistions, Fresenius said, adding that its Homecare business has not yet realised its full sales and profit-earning potential.
